feature_flag: read_facade requires enabled: true (exact boolean) per construction; default OFF
authority_notes: Contract data plus a read-only in-memory dispatch facade. The facade registers no MCP server, opens no socket, stores no data, and is OFF unless constructed with enabled: true exactly; mutate tools are unrepresentable on it and everything not servable answers with the one uniform denial. Wiring real providers (real stores, servers, mutate paths) stays a separate leaf behind its own gates (D27/D28/D29 activation, OD-08 physical tuples).
